LanguageData.OmniWorkstation_ToggleDesc: Enables or disables automatic work scheduling for this workstation.
LanguageData.OmniWorkstation_RadiusDesc: Uses a slider or input field to set the range in which this workstation may search, haul, and perform work.
LanguageData.OmniWorkstation_WorkFilterDesc: Choose which vanilla and mod work types this workstation may schedule.
LanguageData.OmniWorkstation_WorkFilterHelp: This configuration belongs to this workstation. In overlapping areas, work is allowed when any covering workstation enables its type.
LanguageData.OmniWorkstation_AllowCrossMapWorkDesc: Off by default: proxies work only on their home map and do not take jobs on other floors or maps. Turn it on to allow cross-level scheduling. Enabled on any workstation of a map allows it. This toggle is independent of the cross-map entry authorization mode.
LanguageData.OmniWorkstation_ResetFilterDesc: Restores the default work type set: firefight, doctor, basic, cook, brew, hunt, construct, grow, mine, plant cut, smith, tailor, craft, haul, clean, and research.
LanguageData.OmniWorkstation_ApplyAllStationsDesc: Applies this workstation's work type configuration to every other universal workstation on this map.
LanguageData.OmniWorkstation_CopyFilterDesc: Copies this workstation's work type configuration so it can be pasted into other workstations.
LanguageData.OmniWorkstation_PasteFilterDesc: Applies the copied work type configuration to this workstation.
LanguageData.OmniWorkstation_FilterCopied: Copied this workstation's work type configuration.
LanguageData.OmniWorkstation_FilterPasted: Pasted the copied work type configuration onto this workstation.
LanguageData.OmniWorkstation_FilterClipboardEmpty: The clipboard is empty. Click "Copy" in a work types window first.
LanguageData.OmniWorkstation_UnclassifiedWorkDesc: Controls standard WorkGivers that do not declare a WorkTypeDef. Enabled by default.
LanguageData.OmniWorkstation_FilterApplied: Applied the work filter to {0} universal workstations on this map.
LanguageData.OmniWorkstation_ProxyLimitDesc: Sets the total number of work proxies shared by all universal workstations on this map. Multiple proxies may use one workstation concurrently.
LanguageData.OmniWorkstation_RecreateProxiesDesc: Destroys every work proxy on this map and creates a fresh batch. Items the proxies are carrying or wearing are dropped on the ground first. Use this to recover from proxies stuck in a broken state.
LanguageData.OmniWorkstation_OpenStatusDesc: Shows active work proxies, their current jobs, and the work-search state.
LanguageData.OmniWorkstation_Search_NoIdleProxy: No idle proxy available to search
LanguageData.OmniWorkstation_StatsPump: Pump {0} steps · avg {1} ms · max {2} ms
LanguageData.OmniWorkstation_StatsMaintain: Maintenance {0} runs · avg {1} ms · max {2} ms
LanguageData.OmniWorkstation_ProxyLimitTip: A higher limit means more jobs may run at once and higher CPU load; idle proxies sleep and cost nothing
LanguageData.OmniWorkstation_MonitorCollapseTip: Close the proxy status monitor. Reopen it from a universal workstation command.
LanguageData.OmniWorkstation_MonitorDetailTip: Open the full proxy status window.
LanguageData.OmniWorkstation_MonitorResizeTip: Drag the lower-right corner to resize. Window height controls how many proxies are shown at once.
LanguageData.OmniWorkstation_MonitorSearchTip: Search proxy names or current work.
LanguageData.OmniWorkstation_MonitorSearchEmpty: No active proxies match the search.
LanguageData.OmniWorkstation_MonitorToggleDesc: Show or hide the global proxy status monitor window.
LanguageData.OmniWorkstation_GlobalWorkDesc: Global automatic work toggled: when off, workstations on every map stop dispatching work and recall their proxies into the cryptosleep storage of the map their workstation is on. Proxies are not destroyed; carried items are dropped first.
LanguageData.OmniWorkstation_EntryAuthDesc: Controls whether work proxies may enter a map whose entrances are not covered by any workstation radius. Entrances include stairs, portals, and boarding points of crewed vehicles.
LanguageData.OmniWorkstation_EntryAuthStrict: Strict: never dispatch to unauthorized maps (recommended)
LanguageData.OmniWorkstation_EntryAuthStrictDesc: A workstation radius must cover the entrance leading to that map before proxies will work there.
LanguageData.OmniWorkstation_EntryAuthWarn: Warn only: still dispatch, just log it
LanguageData.OmniWorkstation_EntryAuthWarnDesc: Keeps vanilla behaviour and only logs that a proxy went to an unauthorized map, for diagnostics.
LanguageData.OmniWorkstation_ProxyReclaimed: Stopped 1 work proxy and recalled it to its owning pool.
LanguageData.OmniWorkstation_RepairPoolDone: Repaired the work proxy pool: {0} newly created.
LanguageData.OmniWorkstation_ManagerOpenDesc: Shows every proxy pool on every map: each proxy's owning map, its current map and position, and its current job — plus batch rebuild, batch repair, and per-proxy recall.
LanguageData.OmniWorkstation_ManagerRepairAllDone: Repaired every proxy pool: {0} newly created.
